(rule ((= pred (Bop (LessThan ) a b))
       (= if_e (If pred inputs thn els))
       (= a (Get inputs i))
       (= b (Get inputs j))
       (= (Get thn k) (Get (Arg ty (InIf true pred inputs)) j))
       (= (Get els k) (Get (Arg ty (InIf false pred inputs)) i)))
      ((union (Get if_e k) (Bop (Smax ) a b)))
        :ruleset if-tiny )
